title: So i made a game to play with friends out of curiosity, then i liked it.
author: FreeQ1337
selftext:
I tagged it as a Demo because well... it is kinda a demo i think, though it is fully playable and CAN be fun in multiplayer. (need to learn, no tutorial)

Sooo.... i've never used AI before. I dabbled with unity etc. before AI even was a thing. (yes im old).

It started as a curiosity project but now its a CoH/DoW2 style skirmish (with way shittier graphics) and i think its kinda fun.

I used AI for most of it and now it has become my main workflow to expand the game.

Nothing crazy, one task at a time - Blender and Godot.

One feature, one add, even the smallest ones. I know its probably not the most efficent but here we are.

I tried to "put a muzzle" on Claude to not drift off into the star wars universe (yeah, bad joke).

It turns out one can make a pretty nice game with it - fully functional multiplayer too.

If you want to try it go to [https://freeq2137.itch.io/ww1-prototype](https://freeq2137.itch.io/ww1-prototype)

AI is kinda braindead - i played it mostly with friends in multiplayer.

Armored cars are kinda work in progress as i try to make the graphics more "modern" i guess? I'm making a new branch with better models but i pretty much like the identity it has now.

Much to improve, I really like the sounds though - tried to use real ones as much as possible.

Feel free to ask anything. If you try it notice how nice the cover system works, i always despised how dumb units were in most RTS where you needed to literally point them to the cover.

Attached is a shitty trailer made with AI (obviously haha)

Title is something i came on a whim when I actually needed a "Title" lol.
